descriptionPlain:
Role Overview
We are transitioning our organization to an AI-first operational model. We are seeking an AI Product Engineer to architect and build the company’s central intelligence engine.
In this role, you will be the primary builder of automated intelligence systems—tools that not only retrieve insights but actively trigger workflows, and synthesize strategic intel across our entire business landscape.
Role Profile
This is a high-impact, hands-on engineering role requiring a convergence of three distinct skill sets:
Software Engineering (50%): Building scalable middleware, API integrations, and production-grade applications that connect our data stack to business tools (CRM, Marketing Automation, Support/Ticketing).
AI Engineering (30%): Implementing Agentic workflows, RAG architectures, and LLMs to process unstructured data at scale.
Data Analytics (20%): Leveraging SQL and B2B SaaS metrics to ensure all automation is grounded in accurate, governed data.
Key Responsibilities
1. Building the "Enterprise Brain" (Architecture & Integration)
Develop a unified intelligence layer that ingests signals from disparate sources (Product Telemetry, CRM, Call Transcripts, Marketing inputs) and processes them into actionable outputs.
Build robust integrations/webhooks to push AI-generated insights directly into workflow tools (e.g., pushing "Churn Risk" alerts into Salesforce
2. AI Logic & Agent Implementation
Architect "Agentic" workflows where LLMs are granted permission to perform tasks 
Implement advanced RAG to ground AI outputs in company documentation, historical data, and strategic context.
Ensure rigorous evaluation and guardrails for non-deterministic models to prevent "hallucinations" in critical business workflows.
3. Data Engineering & Governance
Collaborate with Analytics Engineers to ensure the underlying data pipelines support real-time or near-real-time AI applications.
Maintain security and privacy standards, ensuring that AI agents respect data access permissions across different departments.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Software Engineering: 5+ years of experience in Python development, with strong proficiency in API development (FastAPI/Django) and building integrations between SaaS platforms.
AI/ML Application: Proven experience building applications using LLM APIs and orchestration frameworks, Experience with "Agent" concepts.
Data Proficiency: Strong SQL skills and familiarity with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery).
Preferred Qualifications:
Business Systems Knowledge: Experience working with APIs for major B2B tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Jira, Marketo).
Workflow Automation: Experience with tools like Airflow, Zapier/Make (advanced usage), or custom workflow engines.
B2B Domain Expertise: Understanding of the interplay between Sales, Product, and Customer Success.
Competencies
The "Builder" Mindset: You are comfortable taking a high-level strategic requirement from leadership (e.g., "We need to automate lead qualification") and independently architecting and coding the solution.
Systemic Thinking: You understand how a change in product data schema impacts the downstream marketing automation flow.
Adaptability: You can switch contexts rapidly—from debugging a SQL query for Strategy to refining a prompt for Customer Support automation.

descriptionPlain:
Who we are
Mindtickle is the leading AI-powered revenue enablement platform, helping sales teams learn faster, practice smarter, and perform at their best. We bring together onboarding, training, coaching, content, digital sales rooms, conversation intelligence, and AI role-plays into one platform so revenue teams have everything they need to build winning sellers.
Global companies, like Fortune 500 organizations, trust Mindtickle to support their revenue teams. Customers and industry analysts have also recognized us. G2 has ranked us the #1 Sales Training & Onboarding platform for 28 consecutive quarters, and Forrester has recognized Mindtickle as a Leader in revenue enablement. Mindtickle was also recognized as AI-Based Sales Solution of the Year by the 2025 AI Breakthrough Awards and has received Stevie Awards for Technology Innovation and Customer Support Excellence.
At Mindtickle, we're helping companies create high-performing revenue teams, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.


Job Snapshot
We are looking for a Client Partner who will serve as a strategic advisor and trusted long-term partner to Mindtickle's most important enterprise clients. This is not a traditional account management role; it sits at the intersection of management consulting, client engagement, and business transformation. You will own the end-to-end client relationship post-contract: driving value delivery, shaping how clients embed Mindtickle into their revenue strategy, and influencing C-suite stakeholders on long-term business outcomes. The ideal candidate brings a structured, hypothesis-driven approach to client problems, is comfortable operating at the executive level, and has a track record of driving measurable impact within complex, multi-stakeholder engagements.
This is a US Shift role. The timings can be from 4 pm - 1 am or 6:30 pm - 3:30 am IST.

lists.content:
• Serve as the senior strategic advisor for a portfolio of enterprise clients, owning the relationship from contract signature through long-term value realisation.
  • Diagnose client business challenges using structured frameworks, and design tailored engagement plans that connect Mindtickle's capabilities to measurable revenue outcomes.
  • Lead executive-level conversations - QBRs, EBRs, and strategic planning sessions, with C-suite and senior VP stakeholders, presenting insights and influencing decision-making.
  • Build and execute detailed client success plans with clear milestones, owners, and business impact metrics.
  • Drive product adoption by understanding client workflows, identifying change management barriers, and designing programmes that embed Mindtickle into core sales processes.
  • Proactively identify risks to client outcomes and renewals, developing and executing mitigation strategies before issues escalate.
  • Identify and build the commercial case for expansion opportunities (cross-sell and upsell) grounded in demonstrated business value.
  • Track and report on engagement health using metrics including ROI, MAU, GRR, NRR, and client health scores, and use data to drive prioritisation decisions.
  • Serve as a structured voice of the client internally, working cross-functionally with Product, Professional Services, and Support to resolve issues and shape the roadmap.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable engagement methodologies, playbooks, and best practices across the Client Partner team.

lists.text: We’d love to hear from you, if you:
lists.content:
• Have 1-3+ years of experience in management consulting, client engagement, or strategic advisory, ideally with direct experience delivering post-sale value to enterprise clients.
  • Are skilled at structuring ambiguous client problems, developing clear recommendations, and driving implementation, not just advising from the sidelines.
  • Have led complex, multi-stakeholder programmes and can manage competing priorities across a portfolio of large accounts simultaneously.
  • Are confident presenting to and influencing C-level executives and senior business leaders, with the ability to adapt your communication style to the audience.
  • Bring strong commercial acumen, you understand how enterprise businesses work, can build a credible ROI narrative, and know how to tie product value to board-level priorities.
  • Are data-driven: comfortable building analyses, tracking business impact metrics, and using data to tell a compelling story.
  • Have deep knowledge of SaaS business models, enterprise software ecosystems, and how technology-driven change gets adopted inside large organisations.
  • Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex information into clear, actionable insights.
  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and take ownership of outcomes rather than process.

• 1-3 years of total experience in a client-facing consulting or post-sale engagement role at a top-tier firm (e.g., MBB, Big 4, Tier-1 strategy boutique) or in an enterprise SaaS environment.
  • Demonstrated track record of owning client outcomes end-to-end from diagnostic through delivery and commercial renewal.
  • Experience working with or selling into enterprise revenue teams (Sales, Sales Ops, Revenue Enablement, L&D) is a strong advantage.
  • Familiarity with revenue enablement, sales effectiveness, or go-to-market transformation programmes.
  • Experience navigating large, matrixed client organisations and building relationships across multiple business units.
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree from a top-tier institution, preferred.

• Customer ROI metrics (demonstrated business impact).
  • % Monthly Active Users (MAU).
  • Customer Health Score.
  • Gross Revenue Retention (GRR).
  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR).

Job Brief  
 
Mindtickle is hiring an experienced Customer Support Engineer - II to join our Customer Support Engineering team and become the technical heartbeat behind a global enterprise SaaS platform and our award-winning AI solutions. In this role, you will troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in a distributed system across backend services, APIs, data platform, UI interactions, and AI-powered solutions.
 
This role demands a strong working knowledge of cloud fundamentals: debugging of distributed systems, querying and analyzing system data, logs, and traces, writing scripts, and resolving complex backend and frontend issues with precision and speed. You will collaborate directly with Engineering, Product, Quality Engineering, and DevOps, influencing product quality and strengthening customer trust at scale.
 
If you thrive in solving hard technical problems, working with cross-functional teams, excel in high-stakes scenarios, owning outcomes end-to-end, and delighting customers, this role offers unparalleled influence and impact that few L2 positions can match.

lists.content:
Operational Support and Issue Ownership

  • Respond rapidly to customer queries and drive issues to resolution.

  • Provide timely workarounds and temporary solutions to customers for known issues, ensuring minimal disruption while long-term fixes are being implemented.

  • Own support tickets end-to-end, ensuring SLA compliance and serving as an escalation point.

  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, QE and DevOps to eliminate systemic issues and reduce ticket volume.

  • Work independently with strong planning and task management skills.

  • Use data analysis to make actionable, data-driven recommendations.

    • Technical Investigation, Diagnostics and Root Cause Analysis

  • Diagnose, reproduce, and debug complex issues across backend services, APIs, data flows, UI behavior, and AI-driven components.

  • Capture and analyze browser logs, HAR files, network traces, and client-side errors using modern observability tools.

  • Analyze AI-driven decision paths, validate model outputs, and identify anomaly or drift patterns.

  • Troubleshoot integrations with external systems, authentication flows, and third-party platforms.

  • Leverage tools such as Zipy, DataDog, SumoLogic, FullStory, Mixpanel, and Metabase for deep diagnostics.

  • Identify, diagnose, and surface real-world failure modes in AI workflows, partnering with Product and Engineering to address root causes and deliver more resilient, trustworthy AI experiences.

  • Provide configuration guidance and technical solutions to resolve customer issues across environments.

  • Perform structured impact and severity analysis before escalating to Engineering.

  • Establish repeatable auditing frameworks to bring consistency to investigations.

    • Knowledge Building, Documentation and Enablement

  • Build and maintain high-quality runbooks, playbooks, troubleshooting guides, and diagnostic frameworks to reduce repeat incidents and improve response speed.

  • Convert solved issues into product and documentation improvements for L1, customers, Product, and Engineering.

  • Drive internal knowledge sharing by conducting deep dive sessions and post-incident walkthroughs.

  • Communicate solutions clearly to customers and internal teams, translating complex root causes into simple explanations.

    • Scripting, Tooling and Automation

  • Write scripts (Bash/Python/SQL) to automate log extraction, data analysis, replication of issues, and health checks.

  • Create lightweight internal utilities to accelerate diagnostics and reduce manual investigation time.

  • Contribute to building support automation pipelines and AI-assisted troubleshooting tools.

Experience and Background:

  • 4+ years of overall experience and 1-3 years of L2 technical support experience in enterprise SaaS platforms/products (AWS Cloud preferred) in a customer-facing role. 

  • Proven track record handling technical issues in production environments, supporting distributed systems.

  • Experience in supporting a multi-tenant SaaS product or platform; familiarity with multi‑tenant architecture, integrations, and configuration management.

  • Troubleshooting AI-powered Product features

  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting AI-powered features. Able to distinguish model issues from data, configuration, or system-level failures with precision.

  • Knowledge of Authentication, Authorization, and Enterprise Integrations

  • SSO protocols (SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect).

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM) frameworks.

  • Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

  • Just-in-time (JIT) provisioning and SCIM (System for Cross-domain Identity Management).

  • Backend and Systems skills:

  • Strong understanding of database concepts; proficient in SQL for querying, analysis, and data validation. Experience with relational and NoSQL systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and ability to debug data inconsistencies and performance issues, and hands-on experience in Snowflake.

  • Experience querying and analyzing logs, identifying patterns (tools like Datadog, Loki, Sumologic, Splunk, Grafana).

  • Proficient in debugging modern web applications across backend (GoLang/Python) and API layers (REST, GraphQL; gRPC).

  • Familiarity with AWS services including, Lambada, CloudWatch, S3 as well as experience with Kafka, Kubernetes, and Snowflake.

  • Frontend and client side skills:

  • Proficient in debugging React applications.

  • Capture and analyze client logs (HAR files, network waterfalls, browser dev tools, net-export, wireshark).

  • Experience with monitoring tools (Zipy, Fullstory) and BI/analytics tools (Mixpanel, Metabase).

  • Customer Relationship and Soft Skills:

  • Strong written, verbal communication skills and empathy when interacting with customers.

  • Ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with customers and internal teams.

  • Maintains a calm and methodical approach in high pressure situations.

  • Proactive, detail oriented, ​​thrives in ambiguity, adapts quickly to changing priorities, and manages multiple concurrent issues in a fast paced environment.

  • Analyzes and prioritizes issues based on SLAs and customer impact.

  • Good to have:

  • Familiarity with prompt engineering (helpful for L2 support on AI-powered products).

  • Understanding of building or configuring AI agents, including workflows, task automation, and basic agent behavior troubleshooting.

  • Experience in Mobile App troubleshooting on Android and iOS.

Global companies, like Fortune 500 organizations, trust Mindtickle to support their revenue teams. Customers and industry analysts have also recognized us. G2 has ranked us the #1 Sales Training & Onboarding platform for 28 consecutive quarters, and Forrester has recognized Mindtickle as a Leader in revenue enablement. Mindtickle was also recognized as AI-Based Sales Solution of the Year by the 2025 AI Breakthrough Awards and has received Stevie Awards for Technology Innovation and Customer Support Excellence.
At Mindtickle, we're helping companies create high-performing revenue teams, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.


Job Snapshot
A revenue manager runs a business through people. Every week they choose where their limited attention goes: which deal to step into, who on the team needs coaching, which problem to leave alone. An hour spent rescuing one account is an hour not spent developing a rep. The information needed to choose well already exists, but it sits scattered across the CRM, recorded calls, dashboards, and enablement tools, and managers assemble it by hand.
Mindtickle is building Manager Effectiveness, the product charter that owns that choice. It helps revenue managers and leaders direct scarce management attention toward the interventions that matter most across the business and the people they are responsible for.
We need a Group Product Manager to own it. The problem is hard in a specific way: "where should this manager spend their next hour?" has no correct answer sitting in a table, and the products render judgments about people that a manager or a CFO will challenge. You will decide what counts as correct, get customers to agree with it, and defend it. You will have no reports and the full charter: product direction, roadmap, customer relationships, pricing, and revenue.

The problem is hard in a specific way: "where should this manager spend their next hour?" has no correct answer sitting in a table, and the products render judgments about people that a manager or a CFO will challenge. lists.content:
• Define and ship the products that tell a manager what deserves attention right now, why it matters, what intervention fits, and whether the last decision changed anything.

  • Build into the reviews managers already run — one-to-ones, pipeline reviews, team reviews — rather than asking customers to adopt a new ritual.

  • Put a judgment about a rep or a team in front of a manager or a CRO, get them to accept it, and defend it when they push back.

  • Find and run design partnerships with CROs and frontline sales managers, and come back from those conversations with decisions.

  • Represent the product externally on your own: pre-sales calls, escalations, and renewal-risk conversations.

  • Compose the platform's intelligence about deals, calls, and readiness instead of rebuilding it, and hold a clear contract with the teams that own those systems.

  • Shape pricing and packaging for the products you own, and argue your call in terms of what it does to the deal.

  • Choose the next bet with no usage data to read it off, make the case for it, and own how it turns out.

At Mindtickle, AI is part of how everyone works. We expect every team member to use AI to move faster and think bigger.

  • Run the eval loop on the AI in your products — action-based evaluation, error analysis, and observability on what the system does in production.

  • Prototype three paths through a problem in an afternoon instead of debating which one is right.

  • Keep agents running on your own work — repos carrying an agent instruction file such as CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, research runs going overnight, connected tools.

  • Read what the model produces closely enough to catch where it is wrong, before it reaches a customer.

• Owned a B2B SaaS product end to end across several release cycles — direction, roadmap, customers, and revenue.

  • Shipped something substantial, fast, at quality, with a small team, and can say what you cut to get there.

  • Ran an eval discipline for an AI or LLM product in production, including error analysis and observability.

  • Argued eval design with engineers and held a renewal-risk conversation with a CRO in the same week.

  • Ran hard customer conversations on your own, and can name what changed because of them.

  • Changed how you work because of AI, and can say what you did last week that you could not have done a year ago.

• Sales enablement or revenue intelligence experience — knowing what a CRO does with call data and what a frontline manager does on Monday morning is an advantage.

  • Experience building for managers or operators whose job is deciding where a team's time goes — sales management, revenue operations, or workforce analytics — is a plus.

  • Experience with a data-heavy B2B product sold to a business operator in a revenue or marketing org, where the buyer and the configurer were different people, is a plus.

  • Having built AI products that make judgments people must accept — rankings, recommendations, or automated decisions with no human review — is nice to have.

• Flexible hybrid work — we care about output

  • Unlimited paid time off, plus company holidays and all statutory leave entitlements

  • Comprehensive health coverage for you and your family

  • Wellness support - physical and mental health programmes

  • Learning & development access, including Mindtickle's own platform and a dedicated L&D budget

  • Equity participation

    • If based in our India offices (Pune / Bangalore):

  • Fresh meals from our live kitchen — breakfast, lunch, and dinner covered

  • Unlimited tea, coffee, snacks, and beverages throughout the day

  • Spaces to focus, collaborate, or decompress between sessions

  • We mark the moments that matter — birthdays, work anniversaries, and the wins worth celebrating

lists.content:
• Build high-fidelity interactive prototypes that go beyond what design tools alone can express: motion, data states, edge cases for both web and mobile.
  • Use AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, v0) to accelerate prototype velocity without sacrificing quality or craft
  • Own and evolve Mindtickle's UI component library and maintain tight parity between Figma components and production-quality front-end code
  • Define and govern design tokens, theming, and accessibility standards across the design system
  • Participate in design reviews and provide implementation-aware feedback early in the process
  • Explore emerging UI patterns, trends and AI-native UX paradigms, so you keep yourself and the design team up to date. 
  • Create POC’s that push what's possible in our product experience. Show the art of the possible and challenge our teams.
  • Raise the design team's technical capabilities and understanding by sharing learnings and building a culture of craft.

• 8–10+ years working at the intersection of design and frontend engineering. Your portfolio must show both sides of the craft.

  • Production-level proficiency in React, TypeScript, and CSS. You can write code that ships, but you can also whip up a quick experiment or demo.

  • Deep Figma fluency: component architecture, variables, auto-layout, Dev Mode. The whole thing.

  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining a design system in a product company

  • Strong command of motion, micro-interactions, and visual polish. You notice things others miss and know how to add delight to experiences.

  • Comfortable using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, v0…) as part of your everyday workflow

  • Solid understanding of accessibility (WCAG), responsive/mobile design, and performance tradeoffs

  • You are a UI artist who thinks like a designer and builds like an engineer

  • Clear communicator who can articulate design and technical tradeoffs to various audiences

• Design-first environment where you sit within the design team, where craft is taken seriously

  • Real ownership of the design system end-to-end, with influence over how design and engineering collaborate

  • AI-native culture with space to experiment and shape how we use these tools well.

  • 24 Design colleagues, in Product Design, UX Research & Content Design.

  • Work on a high-impact product used daily by thousands of sales teams at enterprise-level companies around the world.

  • MacBook Pro and tools, subscriptions & tokens you need to get the job done.

  • Competitive compensation & benefits.

Job Snapshot
As a Design Engineer at Mindtickle, you are someone who moves fluently between design and code, brings design intent to life with precision, and raises the bar for what "shipped" looks like. You'll co-own our design system in code, prototype ideas before they're fully specced, and be the connective tissue between design thinking and production reality.
This is a new role: part interaction designer, part product builder, part systems thinker, part hacker, part artist. If this is you, continue reading!
